title: Linear response from tilted Dirac cones under strain-induced pseudomagnetic fields
summary: We investigate the transport signatures of pseudo-Landau levels (PLLs) in two-dimensional anisotropic Dirac systems with tilted cones, whose effective bandstructure results from strain-induced pseudogauge fields. In contrast to conventional Landau quantisation, the PLLs exhibit explicit momentum-dependence by being dispersive, leading to finite longitudinal group-velocities. We analyse the transport properties within the semiclassical Boltzmann framework by computing the electrical, thermoelectric, and thermal response in the linear regime, which acquire nonzero longitudinal components.
